sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Water Release, Medical, Stable

system.description:
You attempt to drain the blood from wounded hostile creatures. Select one creatures who has taken damage and are not at full hit points and have ranks of Bleed or is Bruised. The select creature must make a constitution saving throw. On a failure, they take 1d6 necrotic damage for the total ranks of conditions they have between the Bleed and Bruised conditions, and then you reduce the ranks of those conditions to 0.

Finally, if you have Ketsuryugan active when you cast this jutsu, you gain a number of Crimson Charges equal to the total ranks of conditions reduced to 0.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1. If this jutsu is cat at B-Rank or higher, increase the damage dealt per condition rank by 1d6. If this jutsu is cat at S-Rank, increase the damage dealt per condition rank by 1d6.
